name: Moloch
role: Infernal council hawk; counsels open war
description: Category A: Canaanite/Ammonite child-sacrifice deity (Leviticus 18:21, 20:2-5; 1 Kings 11:7). Open question: 1 Kings 11:5 names Solomon's Ammonite deity 'Milcom,' 11:7 names it 'Molech' -- scholars divide on whether these are one god under two spellings or two conflated figures. Milton's bloody-minded warmonger personality for him is Miltonic invention (D) on the biblical child-sacrifice association. See docs/milton/character-catalog.md §II.
narrative_function: Argues for renewed open war against Heaven in the Book II council -- the 'wallowing in agony, choosing more agony' voice the book explicitly does not want Satan's own choice conflated with.
